title: Especialista de Auditoria I
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a
Americanas S.A
. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1300 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A auditoria interna tem como principal objetivo avaliar a eficácia dos controles, identificar riscos e propor melhorias para os processos da organização. Além de desenvolver soluções e automatizações que permitam o monitoramento constante dos controles, reduzindo a dependência de testes manuais, aumentando a capacidade de detecção precoce de falhas e otimização de atividades operacionais, com uso de IA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Desenvolver e realizar manutenção de scripts e aplicações em Python para automação de testes de auditoria, análises de fraude e monitoramentos contínuos;
  • Mapear processos, identificar de riscos e controles, e implementar soluções automatizadas para testes e análises;
  • Criar pipelines de dados e automação da extração, transformação e carregamento (ETL) de grandes volumes de informações;
  • Configurar e administrar ambientes (servidores, agendamentos, integrações com APIs e bancos de dados);
  • Aplicar IA e análise avançada de dados para identificação de anomalias e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Elaborar painéis e relatórios interativos para comunicação de resultados de auditoria e monitoramentos contínuos.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Python, voltado à automação de processos, análise de dados e criação de scripts de auditoria;
  • Vivência em análises automatizadas e monitoramentos contínuos de fraude e auditoria para identificação de exceções e alertas de risco;
  • Conhecimento em configuração de ambientes de execução (servidores, containers, pipelines de dados) para suportar soluções automatizadas;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de monitoramentos contínuos de auditoria e automatização de testes aplicados a grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência com extração e tratamento automatizado de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (APIs, bancos de dados, planilhas, sistemas ERP);
  • Instalação, criação e modelagem de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em gestão e otimização de ambientes de execução (servidores, cloud, containers, agendamento de tarefas);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, etc.).

Será um diferencial, caso você possua:

  • Experiência na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning para aprimoramento de análises e identificação preditiva de riscos;
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento de processos, identificação de riscos e avaliação de controles, com foco em automatização.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.
Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:
Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:
Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente

Nosso Jeito:
Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:
Nosso propósito é
amar resolver a vida das pessoas
, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:
A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Operations Geologist
description:
* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *
The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, aligned with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.
Essential Experience And Job Requirements
Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
Demonstrated long-term experience of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
Strong written and verbal communication skills
The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.
In addition, it would be help if you had
Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells
Well Planning & Design
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to interested parties
Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators
Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and high-reaching environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.

Description

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents. 
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society. 
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & written), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

title: Indirect Lubes Tech Coach
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group:

Commercial and Retail

Worker Type:

Regular

Posting Start Date:

February 27, 2026

Business Unit:

Downstream and Renewables

Experience Level:

Experienced Professionals

Job Description:

What's the role

The main purpose of the role is to build technical capability within North Latin American Macro Distributors to grow and defend Lubricants sales to B2B and B2C Customers with profitability and sustainability. Key responsibility is to give appropriate direct support for complex technical issues of distributor customers among local, regional and GKA (Global Key Accounts) Customers

What you'll be doing

  • Develop and deliver appropriate lubricants training to indirect Shell Sales staff and MDs teams to leverage Value Led Selling, Cross/up-selling approach and mindset referring to our Shell products and to build up consistent technical skills and competences in the distributor staff through continuous coaching in the field;

  • Advise on the relevance to Customer's equipment service life & maintenance action requirements associated with oil analysis results (LubeAnalyst service tool)

  • Work closely with local DAMs (Sales) who have the 'ownership' of the MDs, to provide appropriate technical coaching to maintain and gain business in line with business strategy. Carry out joint visits with Technical and/or sales resources of the distributor to new and existing customers providing field technical coaching to generate sales opportunities, with both existing and new products

  • Build up and develop the technical competencies of the D-FLTS (Distributors Front Line Technical Support - Technical staff from MDs) within the 20+ MDs. DFLTS will be able to correctly specify appropriate Shell products to be used for specific applications (vehicles, machinery and equipment), including the specification of Shell product to replace a competitor's product at a given application. In short time, the ideal target is that through Shell ILTC work the D-FLTS will be able to give immediate recommendations for more than 75% of applications required by Customers from different sectors. Build up with D-FLTS a confident knowledge transfer space and a collaborative mindset to win together where we operate.

  • Jointly with DAM (Shell Sales Manager for MDs), one objective is to provide appropriate training and field coaching for the D_FLTS using the global standard modules and guidelines included in the DVP program, in and promote the use Service tools as LubeCoach and LubeAdvisor to get self-capability to manage technical customers' queries and improve their product-application-services expertise.

  • To give the appropriate direct support for complex technical issues of distributor customers

  • Provide direct support in case of complex technical issues or customer claims, especially to larger accounts and to Top5 /Big 5 accounts

  • Work with MDs at complex B2B customers Site Assessments and CVP joint construction for large contracts. Help support SPANCOP (Sales Process) movement and business growth and defense

  • Provide the appropriate technical support and Services to FWS (B2C business channel) in line with product portfolio and approvals

  • Provide HSSE, Occupational Health, safety and product disposal advice to distributors to handle customers and frontline sales in line with local legislation requirements. Actively keep them up to date with changes in legislation

  • Refer complex technical issues to the PAS (Senior Global Technical Group) network for resolution, working with them to ensure issue is completed satisfactorily, with local customer follow up by the technical staff as necessary

  • Feedback to PAS on: business cases, field evaluations, technical market information and trends, competitor activities, customer feedback. It is a key responsibility of the FLTS to work with the PAS network to develop the delivery of cross border second line support for lubricants

  • Exploiting the use of Sales First tools through integrated SPANCOP with Sales one and delivering Customer testimonials (DVrs) according to global needs and guidelines, in order to provide proven Technology Leadership and to enhance Technical Intimacy image or Value Led examples

  • Receive referrals of technical problems or complaint from the reseller or MD and work to resolve them through the source or, if relevant, directly with the customer. Feedback to the source originator to ensure continual improvement in the fielding of enquiries and understanding of technical issues

  • Liaise with Operational Portfolio Managers for product portfolio issues as appropriate. Manage portfolio harmonisation process at distributor level

  • Acting and behaving according to Shell Global Business Principles, Code of Conduct, HSSE standards and rules

Note: This is a home‑based office role in Brazil

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer

  • Bachelor's degree (e.g., BSc, BEng) in Engineering or a comparable technical skillpool

  • Minimum five years' experience in a technical (lubricants & applications) environment as a Field Engineer

  • Mandatory Spanish and English fluency (written and spoken)

  • Proven track record in technical and commercial competence development in B2B environment (specially Heavy Industries)

  • Experience in distributor management beneficial (i.e., DICE training)

  • Demonstrates interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills

  • Estimated: 50% Travel availability

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.

  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

  • Benefit from flexible working hours.

  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.

  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.

  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.

  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.

  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world's most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here .

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell's strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net-zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

title: AI Pilot Assistant
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ) to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand As an AI Agent Assistant, you'll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high-quality results. In this role, you won't just review what AI produces — you'll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world application. Your day-to-day may range from fact-checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human-AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well-reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher-quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper-than-user-level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.
  • You are skilled in web searching, fact-checking, intent-checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.
  • Your level of English is upper-intermediate (B2) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $8/hour depending on your skills, experience, location and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

description:
A New Wave é uma empresa global de tecnologia focada no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para a indústria minero-metalúrgica, com forte atuação em projetos ligados à transição energética.

Somos uma empresa que atua com tecnologias disruptivas, investimento em Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento e parcerias globais, desenvolvendo soluções que reduzem emissões, otimizam recursos naturais e promovem a economia circular.

Venha ser um Waver

Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos aplicados a processos industriais, dados experimentais e bases operacionais. A posição atuará em parceria com engenheiros e especialistas, transformando dados complexos em insights estratégicos e soluções analíticas escaláveis.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e de machine learning para problemas de regressão, classificação e otimização;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados industriais estruturados e conjuntos de dados experimentais;
  • Realizar engenharia de atributos, seleção de variáveis e validação de modelos;
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas como Random Forest, XGBoost, Cubist, PLS e PCA;
  • Avaliar desempenho de modelos por meio de métricas como RMSE, MAE, R² e validação cruzada;
  • Documentar análises e comunicar resultados para públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Atuar em conjunto com engenheiros de ML na preparação e implantação de modelos.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Estatística, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente (Mandatório)
  • Experiência sólida com Python ou R, incluindo bibliotecas como pandas, numpy e scikit-learn;
  • Forte base estatística consistente aplicada à modelagem preditiva;
  • Experiência com pipelines de machine learning e versionamento com Git;
  • Vivência com análise de dados industriais ou de processos;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem como AWS, Azure ou GCP.

Por que trabalhar na New Wave?

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e inovadores, com impacto global;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, em rápida expansão internacional;
  • Cultura colaborativa, com foco em tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa em pleno crescimento.

title: Software Engineer - Go - Container Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical is building a new generation of Ubuntu‑based container images to simplify open‑source application deployment across the world. These container images will be free to use with long‑term security commitments, and engineered for performance, security and usability. As with Ubuntu, we will work in the open and welcome community participation.

In this role, you’ll be developing the tools and technology for building and maintaining this new generation of container images. You’ll be working with multiple teams, both inside and outside Canonical, to ensure we deliver container images with the highest quality whilst maintaining a seamless Ubuntu user experience. You will also be highly involved in the implementation and maintenance of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery automation around these container images, for which you are expected to demonstrate deep insights into container‑based DevOps.

You will be contributing to fast‑moving products like Rocks (OCI images) and Chisel, and thus have the chance to help steer and consolidate this new team. You’ll gain experience with numerous container technologies and participate in exciting and exploratory tasks, where your feedback will be critical for the decision‑making process. As an engineer, your seniority will be based on your software development background and ability to lead junior team members.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical. This is an exciting opportunity for experienced software engineers looking for a place to leave their mark, who are passionate about shaping an open source product with the highest quality, with and for the community!

Location

EMEA

Responsibilities

  • Build robust, scalable, leading‑edge container images
  • Work on automated Ci/CD processes for building, testing and publishing our container images
  • Write tools and tests for assessing security compliance and cloud‑native compatibility
  • Work in Go to deliver new functionalities to our container‑building tools
  • Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Provide technical feedback for the team’s decision‑making process
  • Engage with the open‑source community as a subject‑matter expert
  • Grow our knowledge base and write documentation
  • Work in a collaborative, agile and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor and help hiring
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

Qualifications

  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are a team player and have experience in collaborative development
  • You have worked with CI/CD systems (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Concourse CI, etc.)
  • You have a track record of delivering timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience with container images and containerised operations
  • You master at least one container management/orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • You have significant experience with Go
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration and package management
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical concepts
  • You bring clarity to technical and engineering discussions
  • You are someone who strongly believes that sharing is caring, and knowledge is power
  • Your skills range from those of a Graduate to a mid‑senior Software Engineer
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree

Benefits

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
Somos a Companhia de Jesus, também conhecida como Ordem dos Jesuítas, fundada pelo basco Inácio de Loyola e aprovada oficialmente pelo Papa Paulo III, em 27 de setembro de 1540. Em quase 480 anos de história, temos colaborado com a transformação da sociedade por meio da espiritualidade, da promoção social, do diálogo intercultural e inter-religioso, do serviço da fé e da promoção da justiça. Oferecer educação de qualidade é outra marcante característica da Companhia de Jesus, responsável pela produção de conhecimento para o desenvolvimento social por meio da pesquisa científica e do aprofundamento intelectual.

Atualmente, somos cerca de 16 mil jesuítas atuando em torno de 100 países dos cinco continentes. Hoje, no Brasil, são mais de 450 jesuítas e 8 mil colaboradores atuando em 21 estados brasileiros e Distrito Federal, nas áreas Educação, Social, Espiritualidade, Serviço da Fé, Juventude e Vocacional, entre outras.

Requisitos

  • Escolaridade : Curso superior completo em áreas afins, como Ciências da Religião, Filosofia, Teologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Identificação e abertura à espiritualidade inaciana e à missão da Companhia de Jesus.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial e/ou viagens e trabalho colaborativo.
  • Disponibilidade para participação das formações referentes à espiritualidade e carisma inaciano.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência ou formação na espiritualidade inaciana.
  • Habilidade para tocar instrumento musical (violão e/ou teclado), com participação em momentos celebrativos e pastorais.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e promover momentos de oração e reflexão para a comunidade educativa, conforme o Projeto de Formação Humana e Cristã, bem como o Projeto Político e Pedagógico da unidade.
  • Organizar e executar ações pastorais institucionais, como Semana Santa, Semana Inaciana dentre outras. Promover e acompanhar os Exercícios Espirituais de Santo Inácio de Loyola junto à comunidade educativa.
  • Contribuir com os processos formativos especialmente nas dimensões socioemocional, espiritual e religiosa.
  • Participar da acolhida e integração de colaboradores, fortalecendo a identidade e a missão institucional. Planejar e acompanhar os Dias de Formação Permanência conforme Projeto Político e Pedagógico da instituição.
  • Zelar pela vivência do carisma inaciano e das diretrizes da Rede Jesuíta de Educação no cotidiano escolar.

description:
About The Job

At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and life-science organizations to build and train cutting-edge AI systems grounded in real-world scientific expertise.

As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you will serve as a field-focused scientific communicator, helping translate complex clinical and biomedical data into clear, actionable insights for healthcare professionals (HCPs). Your expertise ensures that clinical evidence, safety data, and scientific narratives are accurately represented and effectively delivered across medical and research channels.

Organization

Organization : Alignerr Position : Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Type : Hourly Contract Compensation : $35–$75 /hour Location : Remote Commitment : 10–40 hours/week

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deliver scientific communication strategies for healthcare providers based on clinical trial data, medical evidence, and real-world insights.
  • Interpret, summarize, and present complex scientific and medical information in a way that is accurate, clear, and useful for HCPs.
  • Support AI research initiatives by validating medical content, reviewing outputs, and ensuring scientific integrity across models and datasets.

What We’re Looking For

  • Background in medical affairs, clinical research, or scientific communications, with experience engaging healthcare professionals.
  • Strong ability to interpret clinical data, publications, and regulatory materials and communicate them effectively.
  • Experience working in a field-based or externally facing medical role, such as Medical Science Liaison, clinical educator, or scientific advisor.

Preferred

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead impactful contributions to cutting-edge AI and life-science projects.
  • Exposure to advanced AI systems and how scientific knowledge is integrated into them.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.

Application Process (Takes 15–20 min)

  • Submit your resume
  • Complete a short screening
  • Project matching and onboarding

PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.

description:
Sobre a Karoon Energy

Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

Responsabilidades

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou de Controle e Automação.
  • Experiência prática sólida em FPSO com: Kongsberg ICSS (K‑Chief / K‑Spice), Siemens PCS 7 / TIA Portal, Rockwell Automation ControlLogix / PlantPAx.
  • Conhecimento comprovado em: Automação de processos e sistemas marítimos FPSO, Gestão e racionalização de alarmes, Projeto e testes operacionais de SIS, Domínio de ferramentas: SPI (INtools), Aveva Instrumentation, AutoCAD.
  • Ambientes de configuração de sistemas de controle.
  • Experiência direta com: Operadores de FPSO, Estaleiros.
  • EPCs e principais OEMs.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Experiência com: FAT / IFAT / SAT offshore.
  • Integração e comissionamento em estaleiros.
  • Operações com produção em andamento.

Instrumentação

  • Atuar como autoridade técnica para instrumentação de campo instalada nos topsides e sistemas marítimos do FPSO, incluindo: Sistemas de processo (óleo, gás, tratamento de água), utilidades (geração de energia, HVAC, nitrogênio, gás combustível), sistemas marítimos e de casco (medição de tanques, lastro, porão/bilge, gás inerte).
  • Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar: Datasheets de instrumentos, cálculos de dimensionamento, desenhos de instalação e hook‑up adequados para ambientes offshore e marítimos.
  • Garantir adequação offshore com foco em: Certificações marítimas, proteção contra corrosão, classificação de áreas de risco.
  • Manter e otimizar: Índices de instrumentos, listas de I/O, diagramas de malha (loop diagrams) utilizados nas bases de dados do ICSS do FPSO.
  • Assegurar a integração completa dos instrumentos de campo com o ICSS do FPSO e com pacote de sistemas de controle.

Automação

  • Ser responsável pela arquitetura do Sistema Integrado de Controle e Segurança (ICSS) do FPSO, incluindo tipicamente: DCS, ESD, Sistema de Detecção de Incêndio e Gás (Fire & Gas), Sistemas marítimos, Interfaces de gerenciamento de energia
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico para: Kongsberg K‑Chief / K‑Spice (plataforma principal), Siemens PCS 7 / TIA Portal (utilidades e pacotes comuns), Rockwell Automation ControlLogix / PlantPAx (sistemas OEM e brownfield)
  • Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar: Especificações Funcionais de Projeto (FDS), Narrativas de controle, Matrizes de Causa e Efeito, Filosofia e racionalização de alarmes (ISA‑18.2 / EEMUA 191)
  • Garantir que o projeto do sistema suporte: Operações de alta disponibilidade, Redundância e comportamento fail‑safe, Manutenção online e continuidade operacional
  • Gerenciar interfaces específicas de FPSO, incluindo: Sistemas de automação marítima, Sistemas de controle de produção subsea.
  • Telecomunicações
  • Responsabilidade técnica pelos sistemas de telecomunicações do FPSO, incluindo: LAN / WAN offshore, Fibra óptica e cabeamento estruturado, VSAT e comunicações via satélite, Sistemas PAGA, CFTV e controle de acesso, Rádios UHF/VHF.
  • Garantir integração com ICSS, sistemas de segurança e consoles de operação.
  • Assegurar conformidade com ANATEL, padrões de segurança offshore e regulamentações marítimas.
  • Apoiar atividades offshore de troubleshooting, upgrades e intervenções de fornecedores.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Senior Media Operations Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities

  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
The Canonical Security Operations team is hiring for a Senior or Staff engineer. The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world‑class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends.

This role involves aspects of:

  • Traditional SOC duties - security monitoring, threat hunting, and response.
  • Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.
  • Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.
  • Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.

We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well‑suited to this role.

Beyond securing Canonical's digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open‑source security software.

Junior positions are also available for less‑experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide operational and engineering leadership.
  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operations Center.
  • Design and develop security software and platforms.
  • Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.
  • Assess and improve Canonical's security controls.
  • Mentor early‑career Security Operations engineers.
  • Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.
  • Contribute to open source security.
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.

We are looking for:

  • An exceptional academic track record.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.
  • Professional engineering experience.
  • An eagerness to contribute to open source security.
  • Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure‑as‑Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

Though optional, we value:

  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001.
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market‑leading security tools.
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands‑on ability.
  • Experience with advanced persistent threats.
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.

What we offer you:

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales
